source.title: Energy changes when kaolin minerals are heated

source.boundary_definition: Small electric laboratory furnace held at constant temperature; author says water vapour pressure was insufficient to appreciably retard dehydration. Exact sample mass, geometry and numerical steam pressure not supplied in this paper.
source.frequency_factor_unit: min^-1 interpreted from time coordinates in minutes and Eq3 plus half-time table; unit absent from A column heading.
source.constant_ambiguities: NumericalR, cal definition and Celsius-to-Kelvin offset not explicitly printed. Separate conventions are diagnostic, not fitted replacements.
source.half_time_evidence: Calculated by the author from the same rate constants, not independent validation observations.
source.thermochemistry_status: Table3 formation values partly estimated and contradictory between older sources; no metakaolin thermodynamic phase admitted from these values.
